Meal Planner — Release 3, Push 2

MW-1 the week moves, MO-1 the day speaks. Rendered by Django from the real view, with the before taken from the pre-round template through the same engine. The week holds two recipes on the Monday, a note on the Tuesday, leftovers on the Wednesday and two saved Menus.

The week, on a desktop

The bar gains a More menu for the three week controls; the Wednesday is a leftover row with no stepper; the Tuesday is a note; every day gains a second Add control.

The week, on a phone

Two Add buttons stack rather than sitting side by side, and nothing scrolls sideways at 390px.

Copy this week to…

The Copy button starts disabled. Picking a date asks the server what that week already holds and says it before the button can be pressed.

Save this week as a Menu

A name, and the week is kept by weekday — so it can be applied to a week in any month.

Apply a Menu

Every Menu with its meal count, a trashcan per row, and the Add button disabled until one is chosen. Managed here rather than on a screen of its own.

A planned night

Three suggestions, so a night you are not cooking is one tap. It buys nothing.

Eat it again

Leftovers on another day, and the dialog says they cost nothing on the shopping list. The date box will not go earlier than the day it was cooked.

What moved

Measured in the rendered page. The highlighted rows are the ones this push changed.
